name: A Night With Neil
source: "A Night With Neil" is the first in, hopefully, a series of choose-your-own-adventure text games focusing on my various characters. Hang out with Neil! Get banged by Neil! Get ate by Neil!
translation: 《与尼尔共度良宵》（A Night With Neil）是我围绕笔下各色原创角色打造的互动选择式文字游戏系列的首部作品（但愿能顺利做成系列！）。和尼尔一起消磨时光！被尼尔狠狠疼爱！再被尼尔一口吃掉吧！
